besluite.fout: Missing AWS 2017 comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb ('n munisipale watervragmotor bring; die gesin dra).
besluite.rede: Both halves are full clauses with their own subjects, so the comma is required; no words or meaning change.
'Haar dorp het self 'n hospitaal' is natural Afrikaans (compare 'Ek het self 'n motor') and its emphatic 'self' carries the contrast with Thabo's distant hospital; the proposal is a lateral move.
